paper.title: Repurposing Alzheimer's and ovarian cancer drugs as sonosensitizers for glioblastoma via a positive-unlabeled learning and 3D bioprinting-based new approach methodology (NAM).

source.title: Repurposing Alzheimer's and ovarian cancer drugs as sonosensitizers for glioblastoma via a positive-unlabeled learning and 3D bioprinting-based new approach methodology (NAM).

study.design: Primary computational positive-unlabeled screening plus in-vitro U-87 MG spheroid validation
study.cellLine: ATCC U-87 MG immortalized human glioblastoma cells

results.outcome: Positive-unlabeled drug classifier and candidate predictions
Drug-only 72h ATP spheroid viability IC50 comparison
24h spheroid viability after drug and ultrasound combinations
72h carboplatin results and unresolved memantine timing/ranking conflict
Attributed mechanism and ADMET interpretation, unverified companion readouts
